Name: Toddlers like parents - Content Patcher
Author: Lumisteria
Description:
Graphical replacement for toddlers. They could look like one of the 12 bachelor of the game, and multiple other characters. 38 differents skintones, 12 outfits, 63 haircuts, 29 eyes colors. Now with baby support and much more !
There is no gameplay implication, just graphical change.

[size=5]4.0.0[/size]
[b]Improved [/b]: The "auto" configs options were removed. Instead, some fields now support an "auto" option (LightColorSkin, DarkColorSkin, ClothesGirl, ClothesBoy, HairsGirl, HairsBoy, HairStyleGirl, HairStyleBoy, ColorEyesGirl, ColorEyesBoy)
[b]New [/b]: Support for 4 more NPC. [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4882]Nikolai [/url](fellowclown), [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3732]Shiko [/url](moopdrea),[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4120] Gregory and Sheila, in Boarding House[/url] (TrentXV)
[b]New [/b]: Support for Babies. They use the same config option than the girl one, when possible. They have only one hairstyle currently.
[b]New [/b]: Seasonal options ("seasonaldress" and "seasonal", for ClothesStyleGirl and ClothesStyleBoy)
[b]New [/b]: Random options for clothes ("randomclothes") and hairstyles ("randomhaircut"). Use the custom sets to choose what outfits and haircuts will be used at random.
[b]New [/b]: New bachelor-inspired haircuts for toddlers.
[b]New [/b]: Ginger Sebastian is now an option for hair color. Use "sebastianginger" in HairsGirl and/or HairsBoy fields in the config.
[b]New [/b]: three news outfits !
[b]New [/b]: enable or disable girl toddler, boy toddler and baby. Useful to use this mod with another mod changing toddlers.

[b]Special thanks[/b] : big thanks to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/74479268]fellowclown[/url]. He provided me a tool that made some updates a lot easier. Look at his cool NPC !

[size=3]3.1.0[/size]
Halloween update :
This update adds 10 cute costumes for your kids : fairy, flower, fortuneteller, ghost, mouse, mummy, owl, queen of sauce, snowman, and witch.
Choose the costume of your kids and decide if they'll wear it only for spirits' eve, or during all fall for even more cuteness.

[size=6][size=3]3.0.0[/size]
[/size][b]Big update today [b]![/b][/b]
[b]
[/b]- added support for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3173?tab=posts]Lyell [/url]and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3962]John [/url](custom NPCs)[b]
[/b]- added an haircut for each of the 12 vanilla bachelor, or moved the existing ones. Now, when using automod, a toddler of the same sex of the vanilla bachelor will have an haircut inspired by the parent. This is just for automode. In custom mode, you can, as always, use any haircut for any toddler. Options are : 1 to 10 (old) abigailGirl, alexBoy, elliottBoy, emilyGirl, haleyGirl, harveyBoy, leahGirl, maruGirl, pennyGirl, samBoy, shaneBoy, sebastianBoy, and classicGirl and farmerBoy are also possible options. Haircuts 02, 03, 05 and 10 are replaced by new haircuts.
- added skintone for every supported character. Options are : 01 to 10 (old) farmer, abigail, alex, elliott, emily, haley, harvey, john, leah, lyell, maru, penny, raphtalia, sam, sandy, sebastian, shane, sorren, victor, wizard, custom01, custom02, custom03, custom04. skintone 04 was changed a bit since it was very close to maru's one.
- automode will use the color matching the one of the parent if one exists and if the toddler is of the same skintone (light or dark). This can be disabled in setting. Custom mode always allows to set custom values.
- the automode have a failsafe, in case the spouse doesn't have a matching option (for skin or hair).

Have fun with the new options, let me know if you have some wishes for future updates :)
Future plans would be to make haircuts for opposite sex of the bachelor (like, daughter of Sam), and more NPC support if the authors are interested (modders, contact me if it's the case !).

Installation :
Install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]﻿.
Install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿.
Extract this mod into the \Stardew Valley\Mods\ folder.
Run the game once to create the config file.
When auto is true, the outfit, haircut and eyes colors will be the ones of your spouse. If you want to change this, set "auto" to false, then use the config options to your tastes :)

Existing options : toddlers looking like the farmer,  abigail, alex, elliott, emily, haley, harvey, leah, maru, penny, sam, sandy, sebastian, shane, sorren, wizard, or classic toddlers.
There is currently no way to get married to sandy or the wizard in vanilla game, i added them anyway for a bit of variety. Farmer theme is based on the default image when you start a new game. Classic is the default colors of the childrens. [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4040]Sorren [/url]is a custom NPC. Victor is another custom NPC, of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded[/url]. And now there is also [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4021]Raphtalia[/url].
Custom options are based on colors i wanted or found interesting to add. Custom01 : Teal and pink clothes, blond hairs. Custom02 : Green and yellow clothes, purple hairs. Custom03 : Pink and lilac clothes, black hairs. Custom04 : Red and black clothes, light blond hairs.


You got a custom NPC and would like my mod to add childs looking like them ? Contact me and i'll see what is possible :)
